collection.name: Cryptomancers
collection.description: Cryptomancer's Ordinals Collection: A Fusion of Art, History, and Bitcoin The Cryptomancer's Ordinals Collection blends ancient art with cutting-edge Bitcoin technology. Presented by Bitcoin Culture Gods, this collection features unique, 1-of-1 pieces inscribed on Block 9 satoshis, symbolizing a union of culture and digital innovation. As the first multicultural art collection on Bitcoin, it highlights diverse global traditions and marks a milestone in digital art and Ordinals history as one of the largest file size collections.
